inspection.reviewer: Codex direct image inspection of mobile and desktop dark/light captures
findings: The rebuilt Bestiary, Arsenal and Field Manual were inspected in 36 mobile/desktop, light/dark states, including threat filter, weapon comparison and touch controls. All 22 threats and 12 weapons trace to runtime ids; each atlas loads once per page.

Modes and Operations were inspected across 28 light/dark mobile/desktop captures. Direct links for representative game modes and all three authored Operations reached the promised launch with exact route selection and live runtime HUD; saved difficulty and loadout persisted.

Normal and Operation debriefs were inspected in 16 mobile/desktop, dark/light states: primary Play Again or Retry Objective is in the first mobile viewport and score/trust details expand without overflow. Practice exclusion and same-seed behavior are covered by focused run-integrity and rematch tests; the injected browser captures end on wave one, where practice is correctly absent.

Field Lab top, three-valve room, locked complaint and paired-practice comparison were inspected in 16 desktop/mobile dark/light states. The page explicitly labels all three as local unranked models; valve bargains appear before activation, receipts reproduce state, and trial order reverses with the next seed. No full live-Operation behavior or real-player comprehension is claimed.

The full route pass rendered every one of 22 public routes in both themes at 390px and 1440px: 88 states, zero missing headings, footer failures after the root entry gate, page errors or horizontal overflow. Board and Press Kit received eight additional scrolled-state captures; four first-party press files loaded and a download completed.

Passport and Record identity states were captured across guest, local receipt, verified, expired, and failed callback at 390px and 1440px in both themes. Callback URLs drop their token, local progress survives failures, and unavailable cloud controls stay hidden.

Player Record Overview, Runs, Collection, Save & Identity and Build Earned/Setup were captured at 390px and 1440px in both themes; hash navigation, legacy achievements, return from detail and return to play passed without horizontal overflow.

The unified Home console was captured in Classic, Operations, Arcade, and setup states at 390px and 1440px in both themes, with one Start button, a loaded gameplay image, and no horizontal overflow. Arcade now resolves to Sewer Zombies for a fresh player before Start enables.
Changed public pages, profile, settings, achievements, leaderboard and aim check were captured at 390px and 1440px in both themes.
Dialogs trap keyboard focus, close on Escape, and scroll to bottom without horizontal overflow, including a 195 CSS-pixel viewport simulating 200% mobile zoom.
Twelve combat screenshots at 390px, 1440px and 800px landscape show no tutorial, dock or expanded arsenal overlap with health/ammo across both themes.
The roadmap is scannable by capability; no exposed internal deployment instructions remain.
fixesApplied: Clipped each atlas sprite to its own viewport, shortened repeated page headings, tightened mobile spacing and derived Boss Rush warmup copy from its runtime fact.

Separated game modes from survival rulesets, exposed score/replay/squad distinctions, added three mission dossiers with source-derived route bargains and art, and preserved launch setup through public discovery links.

Moved the next-run decision beside observed evidence and suggested adjustment, separated same-seed replay from practice, grouped long record/score/share tools, and renamed Rage Quit to Back to Command.
Made the Board table horizontally scrollable with an explicit mobile hint, and added a reversible seed control to expose practice-order effects.
Waited for Arcade mode state to settle before enabling Start, preventing a fast click from launching Classic under an Arcade selection.

Separated local identity receipts from active verified sessions; scrubbed callback tokens before verification, allowlisted return routes, gated cloud controls on server/session state, and changed raw callback errors into recovery guidance.
Grouped scattered career, history, achievements, missions, saves and build tools into addressable Record and Build tabs; removed duplicate Home progress summaries and made selected tab cues explicit.
Combined Classic, Operations, and Arcade under one Home Start action; moved mobile setup behind an opaque popover and moved the real gameplay preview below controls on mobile.
Replaced the light-theme profile's dark translucent overlay with the theme surface.
Replaced roadmap paragraphs with capability cards and explicit availability labels.
Added a preview and rollback boundary to local progress restore.
Introduced one dialog shell and made dark game panels opaque with safe-area spacing and focus return.
Improved locked achievement and inactive leaderboard contrast, enlarged close targets, and wrapped Settings controls at 200% zoom.
Reserved an upper training lane and collapsed twelve desktop weapons behind an explicit selector; moved the mobile selector clear of combat vitals.
